# Plan: shop house with back return and kitchen garden (butcher's copy)

A generic red-brick shop house, the kind repeated down any high street: a tall shopfront under a painted
fascia and striped awning, two storeys of the family's home above with white-trimmed sash windows, a steep
dark-slate FRONT GABLE to the street, and a lower two-storey **back return** (rear wing) on the west half that
makes the L. The east half of the plot behind the house is the fenced vegetable garden, reached from the
kitchen's back door and by a side passage with a gate from the street.

The gable has a small loft window, dark-oak verges, a slate ridge, and a dormer on each side slope. A tall brick chimney with a dark band and a smoking hay-and-campfire cap rises on the east beside a gravel passage leading to a spruce garden gate and lamp post. Behind, a lower two-storey brick wing on the west half has its own slate gable and smoking kitchen chimney. The rest is a fenced kitchen garden: farmland beds of carrots, potatoes, beetroot and wheat with water, dirt paths from the kitchen and shop doors, compost bins, a water butt, a bench and an apple tree in the far corner.

toolu_01SVCRTK225DjQrRoMioqmux.concept_subject: A narrow, handsome red-brick shop house on its own plot, steep dark-slate front gable to the street. At pavement level a nine-wide open shopfront sits between two dark-oak pilasters; behind the counters the butcher's goods show in pink, brown and red blocks. Over it runs a maroon fascia lettered BUTCHER in white, with a red-and-white striped awning and a dark-oak hanging sign on the right pilaster. To the left a smaller bay holds the family's double door with a fanlight and a timber hood with two lanterns. Above a white cornice, two storeys of brick with three paired sash windows per floor under white lintels, dark shutters on the top floor, white quoins at the corners. The gable has a small loft window, dark-oak verges, a slate ridge, and a dormer on each side slope. A tall brick chimney with a dark band and a smoking hay-and-campfire cap rises on the east beside a gravel passage leading to a spruce garden gate and lamp post. Behind, a lower two-storey brick wing on the west half has its own slate gable and smoking kitchen chimney. The rest is a fenced kitchen garden: farmland beds of carrots, potatoes, beetroot and wheat with water, dirt paths from the kitchen and shop doors, compost bins, a water butt, a bench and an apple tree in the far corner.
